ingredientSections.heading: Crimson King
items: 1 dash Sour Cherry and Cacao Bitters

ingredientSections.heading: Juniper Bough Tincture
items: ½ a cup of juniper branches

methodSections.heading: Crimson King
steps: Add all ingredients to mixing glass.
Add ice and stir until desired dilution is reached. Strain into double old fashioned glass with an oversized ice cube.
Express a lemon peel over the drink and use as garnish.

methodSections.heading: Juniper Bough Tincture
steps: Lightly muddle ½ a cup of juniper branches. Add 150ml over-proof spirit and let sit for 4 days. Strain through a coffee filter and add 150ml of Water.

methodSections.heading: Simple Syrup
steps: Place 1 part sugar and 1 part water in a saucepan and bring to boil. Reduce heat and stir until all the sugar crystals are dissolved. Allow to cool.
